0x0007FC.en: 「If this is all I've got...@　then this is where it ends...!」

0x00086D.en: 「Ugh!@　So this is where it ends...!!」

0x0008F5.en: 「Dammit!@　You won't get me next time!」

0x000A1E.en: 「Is this as far as I go...!?」

0x000B1F.en: 「Tch! So this is as far as I go...!」

0x000B5A.en: 「Like hell I'll blow it here...!@　This ain't funny...」

0x000BAE.en: 「I blew it...!@　Nothing to do but bail...」

0x000CFF.en: 「This is it... The rest is on you.」

0x000DAB.en: 「No good, took too many hits... Retreating!」

0x000DF8.en: 「Well, that's a shame. I leave the rest to you.」

0x000E36.en: 「Eek! I leave the rest to you!」

0x000E7D.en: 「The Granzon... shot down, of all things...」

0x000F28.en: 「Ugh... So I'm the shooting star this time... Ejecting!」

0x000FDF.en: 「Ow ow ow... I give up, my math was off.」

0x001020.en: 「Well shoot, they went and got me!」

0x0010D1.en: 「Ugh! All hands, abandon ship at once!!」

0x001118.en: 「I'm sorry, I leave the rest to you.」

0x00114D.en: 「Damn it! Is this as far as I go...!」

0x001191.en: 「I can't fight anymore! I'm pulling back!」

0x001239.en: 「Beaten in a place like this...@ How green of me...!」

0x001287.en: 「No good, I can't take any more! Retreating!」

0x0012CB.en: 「Is... is this the end for me...!?」

0x001342.en: 「Sorry, I'm leaving the rest to you!」

0x001371.en: 「No good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x0013AF.en: 「Well, well... so this is where it ends.」

0x0013DE.en: 「I can't go on. I'll take my leave.」

0x001469.en: 「Careless of me...@ I'll withdraw for now...!」

0x00168D.en: 「Guhh! Not in a place like this!!」

0x001944.en: 「Melior Esse, born together, at one and the same hour.」

0x00199A.en: 「Those are your flesh-and-blood forms.@ Flame and ice, drawn from human knowledge and thought.」

0x001A59.en: 「Still slumbering on the other side.@ To call Him here, we Melior Esse@ must gather sustenance.」

0x001AF5.en: 「Sustenance... the negative thoughts of living things that hold knowledge...」

0x001B38.en: 「So we make the humans feel terror, agony, and hatred,@ and drive them to die in despair. Yes?」

0x001BA9.en: 「Just so. I now journey to the far north. From@ the northern Septemplum and southern@ Meridemplum, Atrum Exterior may arise...」

0x001C81.en: 「The humans will sink into terror and despair.@ Your time comes after that.」

0x001D27.en: Paris - Earth Federation Army - Joint Chiefs of Staff

0x001D55.en: Earth Federation Army - Joint Chiefs of Staff

0x001D8A.en: 「Your information alone isn't enough.@ Its truth is questionable.」

0x001DF3.en: 「You doubt us, and not the Steel Dragon Squadron?」

0x001E2D.en: 「Given my position, I'd rather trust my own.@ I can't believe they'd turn traitor.」

0x001E8F.en: 「Our investigation suggests that, while missing,@ they may have contacted anti-Federation forces.」

0x001F0C.en: 「And from that you conclude they plotted the President's murder?」

0x001F52.en: 「Yes.@ And having achieved their aim, they fled the scene.@ The Gaia Sabers are pursuing them now.」

0x001FE2.en: 「Strip every Steel Dragon officer and soldier of rank, and arrest them.@ Inform every regional army of this.」

0x00206B.en: 「However, if you're the ones to capture them,@ they're handed to us. The same if they surrender.」

0x0020F4.en: 「We'll question them, verify the facts, and once the truth is known,@ pass judgment in a military tribunal.」

0x00217A.en: 「Shield them,@ and suspicion falls on you as well.@ The same goes if you fail to issue the pursuit order.」

0x00220D.en: 「How high-handed of you.@ Isn't it also a problem that you knowingly took@ the President to the front lines despite the danger?」

0x0022A6.en: 「I'll say it again: the ones who took the President's life@ were unmistakably the Steel Dragon Squadron.」

0x002302.en: 「You will pursue them at once as well.@ Formal orders will also come from Vice President Dan Hendricks,@ soon to be sworn in as President.」

0x0023BC.en: 「You know what that means. An order from the supreme commander.@ You cannot refuse it.」

0x00246B.en: 「After a declaration like that...@ whatever the circumstances, it's a fact Steel Dragon caused@ the President's death.」

0x002501.en: 「On that point, no questioning is even needed, you're saying?」

0x00254D.en: 「If there's falsehood in it,@ it's Alteur who ends up cornered.」

0x002606.en: 「I can't see Colonel Lefina Enfield harboring treason@ and taking the President's life.」

0x002686.en: 「At her age she holds a battle team command and captains a battleship,@ so there's no faulting her talent.」

0x002715.en: 「Though she is a touch detached from the real world...」

0x002758.en: 「You're well informed.@ Have you already poured her some Boulanger?」

0x0027AE.en: 「I was just watching for my chance.」

0x0027F5.en: 「An unforeseen accident, or a trap...@ Alteur Steinbeck's attitude@ rather bears out the latter.」

0x002888.en: 「I see.@ Then, Daniel... strip every officer and soldier@ of the Steel Dragon Squadron of their commission.」

0x0028FD.en: 「Also order every regional army: on sighting@ Steel Dragon, disarm and detain the officers. If@ refused, preemptive strikes are authorized.」

0x002A03.en: 「An order from the supreme commander -- we've no choice but to accept it.@ Still, if Lefina Enfield is who Jacob says she is...」

0x002AC0.en: 「She won't raise a hand against our forces.@ And she's unlikely to obey a surrender order from a frontline unit.」

0x002B5F.en: 「To plead their innocence, they'll choose@ not Kenneth in the Far East, but the Joint Chiefs of Staff.@ That's the most effective route.」

0x002C04.en: 「Then if we issue an order for them to turn themselves in...」

0x002C44.en: 「That won't do.@ Refuse all communication from the Steel Dragon Squadron...@ and if they offer to surrender, ignore it.」

0x002CDB.en: 「Take in that cornered bird,@ and Alteur will have his excuse to strike at us.@ That's his aim.」

0x002D72.en: 「Once more, the Steel Dragon Squadron shall go missing.」

0x002DBB.en: 「I see...@ You mean to run them as an irregular independent strike force.@ In that case, together with the Gaia Sabers...」

0x002E54.en: 「Just so. You'll be the go-between.@ But we won't ease the pursuit.」

0x002EB9.en: 「And I take no part in their actions.@ After all, they're traitors who've slipped our hands.@ ...Do you follow, Jacob?」

0x002F6D.en: 「Yes... the kind of talk that had best vanish with the tape.」

0x002FF7.en: 「In any case, I'll keep you busy.@ Watch anyone tied to Steel Dragon, and secure them if need be.@ Don't let the Gaia Sabers beat you to it.」

0x0030CC.en: 「Among those tied to them is a senator, you know.」

0x003116.en: 「Mr. Taylor Centrum.@ Though he hasn't touched Harper's scythe.」

0x003184.en: 「Centrum...@ How would that clan handle a traitor from among their own...」

0x003211.en: 「Then leave Centrum untouched.@ And as for the investigation... use every means,@ and bring me results, quickly.」

0x0032FD.en: Earth Federation Government - Press Conference Broadcast

0x00332F.en: 「...That is the first report from the site.@ I'll repeat the key points.」

0x00339A.en: 「Today at 10:22 FST, the Far East Command's 1st Independent Special Battle Team...@ known as Steel Dragon, staged a rebellion...」

0x003442.en: 「It attacked and shot down President Grusman's craft@ as he tried to escape@ the Gaia Sabers' flagship, Air Christmas.」

0x003502.en: 「All aboard, including the President, were killed.@ The Steel Dragon Squadron broke from the combat zone and remains at large.」

0x003582.en: 「We've also received word that, when the incident occurred,@ the Gaia Sabers were engaged in battle with the Guests...」

0x003627.en: 「...So the President really was aboard that craft...@ I've... I've done something that can never be undone...」

0x0036D9.en: 「Given an announcement like that, the odds the President@ survived somewhere are slim.」

0x003753.en: 「If I had submitted to the seizure there,@ this would never have...@ My... my judgment was wrong...」

0x0037EF.en: 「No, I'm the one who should bear the blame...@ It was this ship that destroyed the President's craft...」

0x003872.en: 「It came to that in the end, but the timing of@ launching the President's craft just then@ feels deliberate to me.」

0x00391D.en: 「This was no accident...@ It's an assassination dressed up as one.」

0x003989.en: 「The Gaia Sabers'...@ Alteur Steinbeck's aim was not only to seize our machines...」

0x003A22.en: 「It was the President's murder... and, on top of that,@ to drag us into it.」

0x003A90.en: 「And to brand us as the rebels...」

0x003B05.en: 「There's some talk of conspiracy,@ but opinion overwhelmingly condemns us.」

0x003B9B.en: 「They're being held to account, but some say@ that rebelling mid-battle against the Guests@ left us no choice -- it was unavoidable.」

0x003C64.en: 「To begin with... why did the Urchin appear@ at that exact moment...」

0x003CC6.en: 「A lone recon craft is unnatural too...@ It may have been staged as an alibi for later.」

0x003D7D.en: 「Most likely. The Gaia Sabers predicted our actions...@ No, they steered us into escaping the combat zone@ via Formation Breakout.」

0x003E4C.en: 「But it doesn't add up.@ From the start, the Gaia Sabers had all sorts@ of suspicious aspects...」

0x003ED3.en: 「Those were kept gray by presidential authority.@ With the President himself dead, they don't just lose their backing.」

0x003F7E.en: 「Indeed.@ Even staged as an event during battle with the Guests,@ Alteur himself should face scrutiny later...」

0x004023.en: 「Even if it's contained for now as an emergency,@ the Gaia Sabers themselves@ could be driven into a weak position.」

0x0040BC.en: 「If the aim were simply to crush the Steel Dragon Squadron@ and do away with the President,@ there had to be other ways...」

0x004155.en: 「Pinning the President's murder on us at this moment,@ then deliberately letting us flee...@ Alteur's true intent must be hidden in that.」

0x004255.en: 「We can't tell yet.@ Alteur's scheme looks clever, but it's full of holes...」

0x0042CF.en: 「Is it because the unforeseen events -- Steel Dragon's summoning to La Gias,@ the Ruina's appearance -- threw@ his plan into disarray...」

0x004380.en: 「Or is even that already accounted for?」

0x0043C9.en: 「Either way, the situation is overwhelmingly against us.@ Not just the Gaia Sabers -- the Federation Army too@ will come after us.」

0x004471.en: 「We can't engage friendly forces.@　Let's contact the Joint Chiefs of Staff directly and explain the situation.」

0x0044F4.en: 「We have to convince them we have no intent to rebel...@　that this may be a conspiracy@　orchestrated by Alteur Steinbeck...」

0x004599.en: 「But staying here is dangerous.@　While we make contact with the Joint Chiefs,@　shall we head for Comodin Island?」

0x004641.en: 「It's a port of call for the Kurogane,@　so we can resupply and make repairs there.」

0x004697.en: 「...Then I'll gratefully take you up on that.」

0x0046E0.en: 「...Will the Joint Chiefs of Staff@　even hear us out, I wonder...」

0x004764.en: 「But in his own way, President Graien Grusman cared for@ the Earth Sphere's future and humanity's sovereignty...」

0x004824.en: 「To impeach Alteur Steinbeck, who exploited@　that will of his, and to expose@　his conspiracy...」

0x0048B1.en: 「that is the duty of those of us who took part in the@　President's assassination, and our atonement to him.」

0x004986.en: 「...Output from Tesla Drive Unit 1 is dropping.@　It's damage from the earlier battle and high-speed flight.」

0x004A1E.en: 「Unit 2 shows no problems, but given@　what lies ahead, we'll need emergency repairs.」

0x004A92.en: 「Then we'll set down on the water for now.@　Hagane, maintain anti-air watch overhead.」

0x004B61.en: 「Then begin emergency repairs on the Tesla Drive at once.@　Keep full-perimeter watch tight.」

0x004BD3.en: （...Enemies... not just the Guests and Ruina,@　but the Gaia Sabers too...）

0x004C38.en: （What's going to happen to us now...）

0x004C69.en: 「Captain...@　we can only clear our name through action.」

0x004CD2.en: 「I don't believe your judgment was mistaken, Captain.」

0x004D1E.en: 「We never meant to take the President's life.@ We must prove it and expose Alteur's plot, or the@ Earth Sphere's fate hangs in the balance.」

0x004DED.en: 「That's what I believe.@　So, Captain... please, hold firm.@　We mustn't falter here.」

0x004EB7.en: 「Three Stork-class! Coming straight on from six o'clock!」

0x004FB3.en: 「Captain, an abnormal gravity field overhead!@　Detecting a powerful ES wave too!@　I-it's spreading, fast!」

0x00503D.en: 「Where is the ES wave coming from!?」

0x005080.en: 「From the direction of the South Pole!」

0x0050B5.en: 「Th-this is...@　as if it's covering this whole airspace...!!」

0x00510E.en: 「An even stronger ES wave! It's coming!!」

0x0051BE.en: 「Then hold at current altitude, TD hover.@　Keep full-perimeter watch tight.」

0x005214.en: （The enemy, huh...@　Not just the Guests and Ruina...）

0x0052BB.en: 「What's going to become of us now...?」

0x005304.en: （That's right... I can't afford to brood.@　Captain Daitetsu never let the crew see him like that.）

0x005390.en: 「...We can only prove our innocence through our own actions.@　Carving a path out of adversity... that's the Steel Dragon Squadron.」

0x005425.en: 「That's how we've always done it.@　And that won't change from here on.」

0x005494.en: 「So the pursuers are here! Whose are they!?」

0x0054C5.en: 「Then this ship will draw them off!@　Azuki, relay that to the others!」

0x005566.en: 「Where is the ES wave coming from!?」
